name: Benchmark Fixture Pack
primary_use: Run reproducible structural checks against raw prompts, Specification-Driven Coding prompts, and golden artifacts.
output_contract: Harness report with fixture completeness, golden artifact coverage, scorecard shape, and explicit structural limitations.
known_limits: Structural benchmark only; it does not prove semantic product quality.

name: Integration Adapter Pack
primary_use: Discover how agents, app builders, and plugin adapters ingest or route the repository.
output_contract: Adapter selection with source-of-truth files, load order, known limits, and required output contract.
known_limits: Discovery metadata only; tool behavior still depends on the target environment.

name: RAG Evaluation Pack
primary_use: Constrain and evaluate internal document assistants with citations, refusal behavior, access control, freshness, and privacy requirements.
output_contract: Evaluation Scorecard covering groundedness, citation accuracy, refusal behavior, privacy, freshness, anti-genericity, and residual risks.
known_limits: Does not provide an LLM-based semantic judge by default.

name: Targeted Change Pack
primary_use: Guide bug fixes, small features, UI changes, config fixes, documentation updates, security patches, and dependency updates.
output_contract: Targeted change package with inspect-before-edit, probable cause, exact files, minimal patch, validation, rollback, and reduced scorecard.
known_limits: Not intended for full-project generation or broad refactors.

name: Language Companion Pack
primary_use: Keep English public entry points aligned with Italian companion documents.
output_contract: Language policy and public-doc alignment notes without translating every internal Markdown file.
known_limits: Does not make the full repository bilingual.

name: Multi-Agent Governance Pack
primary_use: Constrain multi-agent work with roles, permissions, stop conditions, governance, and release gates.
output_contract: Governed multi-agent blueprint with role contracts, allowed tools, forbidden tools, review gates, scorecard, and residual risks.
known_limits: Does not grant agents extra authority or automate sensitive tool approvals.
